To top it all, there are more men trainers sitting at the front desk so there was no one to even provide this feedback to.

To compare with other gyms in the city, there are 2-3 trainers max, who politely stand on the side and only help when asked which is respectful to everyone. That hasn’t been the experience at Pump.

Limiting the number of trainers in the main area and having them centralized minding their own business instead of gawking at the members and trying to interfere with workouts would make it a better and more approachable environment.
